 PM Kisan Status Update – How to Verify Your Installment on pmkisan.gov.in
 PM Kisan Farmer Support: Under the PM Kisan scheme, an amount of ₹2,000 is provided as the first installment, another ₹2,000 as the second installment, and a further ₹2,000 as the third installment. This money is transferred directly into the farmers' bank accounts via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

 PM Kisan Farmer Support: The PM Kisan scheme is administered by the Central Government. Under this scheme, farmers receive ₹6,000 annually as financial assistance. Beneficiaries receive this amount in installments of ₹2,000 every four months. The funds are transferred directly into the farmers’ bank accounts, helping them cover agriculture-related expenses. The scheme provides three installments of ₹2,000 each. This money is disbursed to the farmers’ bank accounts via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
 Which farmers are eligible for the benefits? 
The PM Kisan scheme is intended for eligible farming families. However, not all farmers are eligible; certain categories are excluded, and it is mandatory to meet the established eligibility criteria.
 With PM-KISAN, financial assistance reaches eligible farmers directly through Aadhaar-linked bank accounts via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). No middlemen, no unnecessary delays—just transparent and secure payments. PM-KISAN: Empowering Farmers, Building Trust! #PMKISAN #DBT https://t.co/AA9OjWZjPC
 — PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (@pmkisanofficial)

 Requirements for receiving PM Kisan funds 
To ensure that farmers receive benefits under the PM Kisan scheme without any issues, they must fulfil the following requirements:
Complete e-KYC: It is mandatory for farmers to complete their e-KYC, which helps in verifying the identity of the beneficiaries.
Link bank account with Aadhaar: Farmers must link their bank accounts to their Aadhaar cards and meet the necessary banking requirements for payments.
 This enables the direct transfer of funds into their accounts. Verify land records: Farmers must ensure their land records are verified. Any discrepancies in these records indicate that the verification process is incomplete, which may hinder the receipt of benefits.
 How to check your PM Kisan status? 
If you wish to verify whether your installment has been credited, you can check your beneficiary status by visiting the official PM Kisan website. For this purpose, you need to visit the official PM Kisan website at https://pmkisan.gov.in/.
You can check information regarding your payment by using the ‘Beneficiary Status’ option available on the official PM Kisan website. If any necessary step remains incomplete, you should contact the relevant department or the agriculture office to resolve it.
